question: Which country did Indian football team defeat to win the Intercontinental Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lebanon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian football team **defeated Lebanon** to win the Intercontinental Cup 2023.
 
• The final was held on** June 18, 2023, in Bhubaneswar**.
 
• India won the match **2-0**, with goals **from Sunil Chhetri and Lallianzuala Chhangte**.
 
• This victory marked India's second Intercontinental Cup title, having **previously won the tournament in 2018**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modern football originated in England** in the 19th century, though ancient forms of the game can be traced back to China, Greece, and Rome.
 
• **Sheffield FC**, founded in 1857, is the world’s **oldest football club.**
 
• The first professional football club was **Notts County, established in 1862.**
 
• The** first official international football match** was played between Scotland and England on November 30, 1872,** in Glasgow.**
 
• **FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association)** was founded in 1904 in Paris.
 
• **The English Football League (EFL)** was founded in 1888, making it the world's first professional football league.
 
• **Real Madrid is the most successful club **in the UEFA Champions League, having won the title 14 times.
 
• A football field must be between** 90 to 120 meters (100 to 130 yards) long** and **45 to 90 meters (50 to 100 yards) **wide, with a goal area of 7.32 meters (24 feet) wide and 2.44 meters (8 feet) tall.
 
• A football match consists of **90 minutes, split into two 45-minute halves, with a 15-minute halftime break.**
